sourceCause: PageSpatialIndex.syncObjects() called syncObject() once per changed id.
syncObject() called findPageObject(), which materializes walkPageObjects(page) for each id.
upsertObject() also performs quadtree-wide remove and items.filter for each id.
Large multi-object transform/align operations therefore repeat page/index work approximately K times.

isolatedMeasurements.workload: flat page objects with existing hierarchy/quadtree algorithms; mutate K object translations then synchronize the spatial index
isolatedMeasurements.note: Timing is isolated source-algorithm evidence, not browser frame/GPU timing and not a Formal Live performance claim.

repair.strategy: Keep per-object incremental synchronization for unique batch size <= existing quadtree capacity; for larger batches call the existing PageSpatialIndex.rebuild() once.

memory.statement: No heap evidence was collected; no memory-leak claim is made.
